ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram shown, which is the producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the diagram is “Food Chain”. In the upper right, there is the sun shining on “phytoplankton (phytoplankton)” in the water. Energy flow arrows point from phytoplankton to zooplankton, then to small fish, mackerel, mahi mahi, and finally to large shark. Reasoning: Producers are organisms at the bottom of the food chain that can use sunlight to make their own food. The one in the diagram that receives solar energy and is located at the starting point of the food chain is phytoplankton, so the producer is phytoplankton.
